title: Orchestrated cold-standby promotion playbook for multi-region private clusters
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create an automated playbook and Terraform wiring to promote a cold-standby private region into active serving during planned failover drills and upgrades. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, gating health checks, sequenced fencing of stateful workloads, DNS and routing handoff, and post-promotion smoke validations for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The intent is to enable repeatable, auditable failover rehearsals that can be run from the Console or via a single CI job.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible Terraform module (private/dr-playbook) that can create necessary promotion artifacts (promotion job, temporary LB, promotion marker) and is covered by unit tests in the repo
Promotion workflow that runs automatically from CI or Console and completes a successful cold->active promotion end-to-end in < 12 minutes in our staging environment
An ordered health-check matrix that gates promotion steps: control-plane readiness, KV cache warmup check, model shard health, storage mounts accessible, and application smoke tests
Automated DNS and route updates (using cloud DNS APIs + optional traffic-steering flag) with rollback on health failures
Comprehensive runbook and audit log output suitable for SRE tabletop review (includes start/stop, observed timings, and failure reasons)
Post-promotion automated rollback trigger if any critical smoke test fails within the grace window
tasks: Design promotion state machine and step sequencing (design doc link below)
Implement Terraform module: modules/private/promotion with inputs for region, cluster IDs, promotion window
Add gating health-checks (control-plane API probe, kv-cache snapshot compare, model-serving-endpoint smoke)
Implement promotion operator (small service/CI job) to execute step sequence and emit structured events
Wire DNS update module and optional weighted traffic handoff using cloud provider APIs
Add experiment hooks in Console to trigger a drill and show live progress and logs
Create runbook (play-by-play) and tabletop checklist for SRE/SE participants
Create Canary test suite and CI pipeline that runs promotion in staging and validates rollback behavior
